description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 13.02.2023 to 19.02.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that determines new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It rescinds a previous notification and establishes regulatory requirements for customs payments, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
